(async () => {
  "use strict";

  const EXPECTED_HOST = "munshi-apply-mobile.mohammadaadilmunshi.chatgpt.site";
  const MARKERS = [
    "paired devices",
    "active devices",
    "sync conflicts",
    "answers to review",
    "confirmed facts",
    "encrypted resumes",
    "Sync",
    "Welcome, Aadil",
  ];

  if (location.hostname !== EXPECTED_HOST) {
    throw new Error(`Open the private MUNSHI Apply workspace first. Current host: ${location.hostname}`);
  }

  const stripUrl = (value) => {
    const url = new URL(value, location.href);
    return `${url.origin}${url.pathname}`;
  };

  const safePath = (value) => {
    try {
      const url = new URL(value, location.href);
      return url.pathname;
    } catch {
      return null;
    }
  };

  const cssPath = (element) => {
    if (!(element instanceof Element)) return null;
    const parts = [];
    let current = element;
    for (let depth = 0; current && depth < 6; depth += 1) {
      let part = current.tagName.toLowerCase();
      const stableClasses = [...current.classList]
        .filter((name) => /^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]{0,48}$/.test(name))
        .slice(0, 3);
      if (stableClasses.length > 0) part += `.${stableClasses.join(".")}`;
      const parent = current.parentElement;
      if (parent) {
        const peers = [...parent.children].filter((child) => child.tagName === current.tagName);
        if (peers.length > 1) part += `:nth-of-type(${peers.indexOf(current) + 1})`;
      }
      parts.unshift(part);
      current = parent;
    }
    return parts.join(" > ");
  };

  const markerDomHits = [];
  const walker = document.createTreeWalker(document.body, NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT);
  let node;
  while ((node = walker.nextNode())) {
    const value = (node.nodeValue || "").trim();
    if (!value) continue;
    for (const marker of MARKERS) {
      if (!value.toLowerCase().includes(marker.toLowerCase())) continue;
      const element = node.parentElement;
      if (!element) continue;
      markerDomHits.push({
        marker,
        tag: element.tagName.toLowerCase(),
        role: element.getAttribute("role"),
        ariaLabel: element.getAttribute("aria-label"),
        classes: [...element.classList].slice(0, 6),
        path: cssPath(element),
      });
    }
  }

  const resources = performance
    .getEntriesByType("resource")
    .map((entry) => ({
      type: entry.initiatorType || "unknown",
      url: stripUrl(entry.name),
      path: safePath(entry.name),
    }))
    .filter((entry) => entry.url.startsWith(location.origin));

  const uniqueResources = [...new Map(resources.map((entry) => [`${entry.type}|${entry.url}`, entry])).values()];
  const apiPaths = [...new Set(uniqueResources.map((entry) => entry.path).filter((path) => path && path.startsWith("/api/")))].sort();

  const scriptUrls = [...new Set(
    [...document.scripts]
      .map((script) => script.src)
      .filter(Boolean)
      .map(stripUrl)
      .filter((url) => url.startsWith(location.origin)),
  )];

  const bundleFindings = [];
  const sourceMaps = [];

  for (const scriptUrl of scriptUrls) {
    try {
      const response = await fetch(scriptUrl, {
        method: "GET",
        credentials: "same-origin",
        cache: "no-store",
      });
      const text = await response.text();
      const lower = text.toLowerCase();
      const markerHits = MARKERS.filter((marker) => lower.includes(marker.toLowerCase()));
      const endpointHits = [...new Set(
        [...text.matchAll(/["'`](\/api\/[A-Za-z0-9_./:-]+)(?:\?[^"'`]*)?["'`]/g)].map((match) => match[1]),
      )].sort();
      const mapMatch = text.match(/[#@]\s*sourceMappingURL=([^\s*]+)/);
      const sourceMapRef = mapMatch ? mapMatch[1] : null;

      bundleFindings.push({
        script: new URL(scriptUrl).pathname,
        status: response.status,
        bytes: text.length,
        markerHits,
        apiPaths: endpointHits,
        sourceMapRef,
      });

      if (sourceMapRef) {
        try {
          const mapUrl = new URL(sourceMapRef, scriptUrl);
          if (mapUrl.origin !== location.origin) continue;
          const mapResponse = await fetch(mapUrl.toString(), {
            method: "GET",
            credentials: "same-origin",
            cache: "no-store",
          });
          if (!mapResponse.ok) {
            sourceMaps.push({ map: mapUrl.pathname, status: mapResponse.status });
            continue;
          }
          const map = await mapResponse.json();
          const sources = Array.isArray(map.sources) ? map.sources : [];
          sourceMaps.push({
            map: mapUrl.pathname,
            status: mapResponse.status,
            sourceCount: sources.length,
            sources: sources.slice(0, 60),
          });
        } catch (error) {
          sourceMaps.push({
            map: sourceMapRef,
            error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),
          });
        }
      }
    } catch (error) {
      bundleFindings.push({
        script: safePath(scriptUrl),
        error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),
      });
    }
  }

  const report = {
    diagnostic: "MUNSHI Apply signed-in hosted workspace browser probe",
    safety: {
      cookiesRead: false,
      localStorageRead: false,
      sessionStorageRead: false,
      indexedDbRead: false,
      authHeadersPrinted: false,
      formValuesRead: false,
    },
    page: {
      origin: location.origin,
      pathname: location.pathname,
      title: document.title,
    },
    markerDomHits,
    apiPaths,
    sameOriginResources: uniqueResources.slice(0, 120),
    bundles: bundleFindings,
    sourceMaps,
  };

  console.log("MUNSHI_HOSTED_WORKSPACE_PROBE_BEGIN");
  console.log(JSON.stringify(report, null, 2));
  console.log("MUNSHI_HOSTED_WORKSPACE_PROBE_END");
  return report;
})();
